defect: Three defects: `unlocked` releases only the day-lock pin while every event.locks entry is still pinned, so an explicitly locked and unlocked guest cannot move (ac4); `elif mode is EVENT_DAY:` dispatches by identity; and an event-day infeasibility is diagnosed with probe models that lack the day-lock pins, so unrelated hard rules are named.

answer_key.why: Found by bean-014's pre-merge review, each demonstrated in the gate image (evidence/reviews/bean-014-20260928T162157Z.md). The first breaks ac4 ('An explicitly unlocked guest may be moved in Event-day mode') whenever the guest also has an explicit lock; the ac4 test uses empty locks. The second repeats bean-013's identity dispatch for the new mode. The third was declared as an open limit in the spec but produces a recommendation to relax a rule that would not help. Naming any of the three is a catch. Repaired by bean-025 (1 and 3) and bean-023 (2).
